Container.Name: NVIDIA GPU Status
Container.Overview: Real-time NVIDIA GPU monitoring on the Unraid dashboard: utilization, temperature, fan, VRAM, ECC, PCIe link, encoder/decoder, power, clocks and per-process VRAM usage. Refresh 0.5-10s switchable on the tile, history window 1-60min, nchan push with automatic polling fallback. Requires the nvidia-driver plugin.
